id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

shouldRetry.description: If the failure is a known flipper, it should be retried. If it's unstable/regression, there's no point in retrying

buildStepName.description: Describes the integ group or JarvisStep the test was run on

testName.description: Full name of test, taken from {@link TestCaseResult}

testCases.description: {@link Tas.TestCase} representation of each testcase with more TAS-related information

testSuiteResult.description: A modified copy of the {@link TestSuiteResult} after TAS handles known errors.

attemptNum.description: The attempt count of the test

title:
Tas.Response when TAS acts upon a test failure. Contains modified {@link TestSuiteResult} along with
various TAS information.
name: Tas.TestSuiteResponse
